name: Microsoft 365 Apps
description: Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise, 64-bit, Monthly Enterprise Channel, without Teams (new Teams is deployed separately with the VDI settings) and without Access, Publisher, Skype for Business and the Bing search add-in. Personal desktops are single-user, so shared computer activation is off.
portalPath: Intune admin center > Apps > Windows > Add > Microsoft 365 Apps (Windows 10 and later): configure app suite, 64-bit, Monthly Enterprise Channel, remove other versions = Yes, accept licence = Yes, shared computer activation = No; excluded: Access, Publisher, Skype for Business, Teams, Bing
reviewNotes: Pick the update channel your organisation uses on physical devices.
Teams is excluded so the VDI-optimised new Teams install (see tools/intune/win32-test-apps) is the only Teams on the host.
